The Orange, led by 43rd-year head coach [[Jim Boeheim]], played their home games at the [[Carrier Dome]] in [[Syracuse, New York]] as sixth-year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. Syracuse received a bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2019 NCAA men's basketball tournament]] as the number eight seed in the West region, where they lost in the round of 64 to ninth seeded [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Orange]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 23–14, 8–10 in ACC play to finish in a tie for tenth place. They defeated [[2017–18 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Wake Forest]] in the first round of the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|2018 ACC tournament]] before losing in the second round to [[2017–18 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]]. They received one of the final four at-large bids to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where, as a No. 11 seed, they defeated [[2017–18 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] in the First Four, and upset No. 6 seed [[2017–18 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]] in the First Round and No. 3 seed [[2017–18 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]] in the Second Round before losing in the Sweet Sixteen to fellow ACC member and No. 2 seed [[2017–18 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
